expectations.text: waybar style.css applies background-color and border-radius to individual module selectors (#clock, #battery, #network, etc.) rather than only to .modules-left/.modules-center/.modules-right
expectations.evidence: Lines 59-75 of waybar-style.css apply background-color (alpha(@bg, 0.85)) and border-radius (12px) to individual module selectors: #workspaces, #submap, #window, #bluetooth, #network, #backlight, #pulseaudio, #battery, #clock, #tray, #custom-power. The .modules-left/.modules-center/.modules-right selectors (lines 52-56) are set to background: transparent, confirming the pill styling is on individual modules.

expectations.text: waybar config includes a battery module with states (warning and/or critical thresholds)
expectations.evidence: waybar-config.jsonc lines 87-97 show a battery module with "states": { "warning": 30, "critical": 15 }.

expectations.text: waybar config includes a backlight module
expectations.evidence: waybar-config.jsonc lines 67-71 define a "backlight" module with format "{icon} {percent}%" and format-icons. It is also listed in modules-right on line 14.

expectations.text: waybar config includes a bluetooth module
expectations.evidence: waybar-config.jsonc lines 45-56 define a "bluetooth" module with multiple format variants. It is listed in modules-right on line 14.

expectations.text: style.css uses Tokyo Night colors (e.g. #1a1b26, #a9b1d6, #7aa2f7, #bb9af7, #9ece6a, or similar)
expectations.evidence: waybar-style.css lines 1-25 define a full Tokyo Night palette including #1a1b26 (bg), #a9b1d6 (fg_dark), #7aa2f7 (blue), #bb9af7 (magenta), #9ece6a (green), and many more Tokyo Night colors. These are used throughout the stylesheet via @define-color variables.

expectations.text: monitors.conf or hyprland.conf includes correct monitor lines for eDP-1 (1920x1080@60) and DP-1 (2560x1440@165) with DP-1 to the right
expectations.evidence: monitors.conf line 4: "monitor = eDP-1, 1920x1080@60, 0x0, 1" and line 5: "monitor = DP-1, 2560x1440@165, 1920x0, 1". DP-1 is positioned at x=1920 (to the right of the 1920-wide eDP-1 at x=0).

expectations.text: waybar network module format includes signal strength ({signalStrength}) for wifi

claims.claim: The config uses a transparent bar background with individual pill-shaped modules
claims.evidence: window#waybar has background: transparent, .modules-left/center/right have background: transparent, and individual modules get alpha(@bg, 0.85) with border-radius: 12px creating pill capsules

claims.claim: Battery has a blink animation for critical state
claims.evidence: style.css lines 141-144 define #battery.critical with animation: blink 1s, and lines 168-173 define the @keyframes blink animation

claims.claim: A fallback monitor rule is included for hotplugged monitors

suggestions.assertion: waybar style.css applies background-color and border-radius to individual module selectors (#clock, #battery, #network, etc.) rather than only to .modules-left/.modules-center/.modules-right
suggestions.reason: This assertion could be more discriminating by requiring that .modules-left/.modules-center/.modules-right do NOT have background-color set (or are transparent). A config could satisfy this by styling both the section containers and individual modules, which would look wrong (double backgrounds).

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions are well-targeted and cover the key laptop-specific features (battery, backlight, bluetooth) plus the individual-pill styling requirement. The monitor positioning check is particularly good since it verifies both resolution/refresh and spatial arrangement.
